question: Can one truth-blind reference-scale axis-completion hypothesis recover fragmented elongated targets while retaining the at-most-three cross-view set across all six consumed families?

contributors: best semantic-local fusion candidate constrained to the majority winning target reference across the three query observations
hypothesis_generation.axis_completion: For every detector proposal, consider its unchanged box, a full-width horizontal band retaining its y span, and a full-height vertical band retaining its x span. Rank all options by the parent layer-18 local score minus 0.05 times minimum absolute log-area deviation to any frozen reference target scale.
hypothesis_generation.reference_vote: Each query contributes its semantic-local fusion top-one winning target reference. Select the majority reference; break ties by deterministic sorted reference order.
hypothesis_generation.deduplication: Deduplicate exact output boxes while retaining all mechanism provenance.
hypothesis_generation.truth_boundary: Axis mode, reference vote, contributors, scores and deduplication are fixed before target boxes or IoU are opened. Truth is used only to evaluate the resulting boxes.
hypothesis_generation.downstream_contract: The bounded set remains unresolved localization uncertainty and requires active or cross-view disambiguation before one target can be authorized.

literature_motivation.source: Dynamic Tiling: A Model-Agnostic, Adaptive, Scalable, and Inference-Data-Centric Approach for Efficient and Accurate Small Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Initial near-boundary detections can guide dynamic patches that repair objects fragmented by fixed tiling. Mechanism motivation only.

literature_motivation.source: Aspect Ratio and Context Aware Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Multiple aspect-ratio configurations and surrounding context can improve localization. Mechanism motivation only.

claim_boundary: All six families were consumed before this axis-completion rule was defined. A pass is Development evidence for a bounded proposal carrier, not fresh confirmation, a learned dynamic detector, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, open-set rejection, raw-phone operation, referent ownership, named entrance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety.
